---
name: Schema refinement
about: Propose a change, addition, or correction to the LAR JSON Schema
title: "[schema] "
labels: ["schema", "v0.1-feedback"]
---

## What problem does this proposal address

A short description of the problem with the current schema — a missing field, an ambiguous constraint, a structural awkwardness an agent or implementer ran into. If possible, include the use case that surfaced the problem.

## Proposed change

The specific field, constraint, or structural edit you propose. If the proposal touches the protocol enum, the `current_state` block, the `context` block, or the `attestation` block, please say so explicitly — those areas have known open questions and your proposal may interact with them.

## Schema fragment (optional)

If you have a concrete schema fragment in mind, paste it here as a JSON Schema snippet. Otherwise leave blank — discussion can converge on the fragment.

## Backwards compatibility

Would this change break existing manifests written against v0.1? If yes, note the migration cost.

## Adjacent specifications

Does this proposal interact with llms.txt, MCP, UCP, ACP, NLWeb, schema.org, or another adjacent spec? If yes, note the relationship.

## Anything else
